name: Koi pond
description: A pond of character-based fish that follow your cursor and create ripples when you touch the water.

name: Streaming text
description: Clyra's word-by-word chat reveal, with opacity fades, partial chunks, and a bounded animation queue.

name: Glyph Card Blue
description: A blue character background with animated gaps that react to your cursor, powered by MetalForge's original engine.

name: Image folders
description: Translucent folders with files that fan out, pin open, and respond to selection with a gentle spring.

name: Morph dialog
description: A dialog that expands from its button or card and returns to it, with the same motion as Nibble's Get Pro modal.

name: Glass reveal
description: A logo revealed through refracting glass, using the same animation as Nibble's Get Pro logo.

name: Abyss Wallpaper
description: Animated blue wallpaper with soft bloom, travelling waves, film grain and vignette. Adapted from the MetalForge public wallpaper preview.

name: Verse Text
description: Selectable React text that prints word by word like a misregistered comic, with CMY plates, shattered letters, halftone debris and seeded idle glitches. Includes replay, controlled frames and reduced-motion support.

name: Buttons
description: Nibble's original primary, secondary and icon buttons, with Inter at the same sizes and weights, Material Symbols, native keyboard behavior, loading and toggle states.

name: Search Input
description: Nibble's search pill with its original Inter typography and Material Symbols, focus expansion, Ctrl/Cmd+K, clear button and Escape handling. A standalone, centered input.

name: OTP Input
description: Nibble's animated OTP input with native paste and autofill, checking and error states, and a gooey merge into Verified. Includes only the code needed to try it and reset.

name: Login Form
description: Nibble's login form with its original typography, logo, Google button, email/password inputs, email-code option and account-mode switch. Provider callbacks keep authentication in your app; the preview sends no credentials or emails.

name: Account Dropdown
description: Nibble's account dropdown with original typography, pixel avatar, profile, grouped actions and theme toggle. Supports keyboard navigation, Escape, outside click and async callbacks. The preview does not modify your account.

name: Glass Alert
description: Glass Alert from onlymoein/liquidglass, with its original refractive glass and interactions. MIT licensed; standalone React source with embedded styles.

name: Pixel steamboat
description: Animated pixel illustration of Mickey and his steamboat, faithfully reconstructed from the reference by @dhruvtwt_. Canvas rendering with moving water, smoke and paddle wheel; supports pause, speed and colors.

name: Money transfer
description: A transfer confirmation with a soft animated glow, blurred processing states and a completed payment receipt.

name: Merge conflicts
description: An interactive pull request with an animated commit graph, conflict resolution, live test checks and a merged state.

name: ASCII image
description: Turn any image into fine monochrome ASCII characters using the same luminance renderer as the Nibble footer. Includes adjustable density, contrast, colors and an optional Nibble mark.

name: Status picker
description: A flowing color orb with a badge that unfolds into an emoji status picker. Choose a status or type your own, with animated labels and a folding pill transition.

name: MCP installer
description: An animated MCP setup card with expanding client tabs, remote and local configuration, editable key tokens, clipboard feedback and connection states.

name: Storage scanner
description: A pixel storage map with a luminous scanning edge, interactive category highlights and particle disintegration when clearing caches or emptying the trash. Original Kubai icons, rendered entirely in code.

name: Navigation dropdown
description: A shared navigation surface that morphs between an image explorer, photographic experience cards and a compact destination list, with directional crossfades and image previews.

name: Activity island
description: A black capsule that reshapes itself around what is happening: a running timer, the song that is playing or an incoming call. It springs between sizes while its contents blur from one state into the next.

name: Message thread
description: A chat with the small details of a native messenger: tailed bubbles, a typing indicator that grows into the reply, and reactions that open with a long press, lift the message and pop onto its corner.
